title: The Courtside Kick
setup: January 1997. During the Bulls' 112-102 win over the Timberwolves, Chicago forward Dennis Rodman kicks a courtside cameraman. Commissioner David Stern announces a penalty on January 17.
question: What is Rodman's penalty?
options: A fine, with no games missed.
A suspension without pay for at least 11 games and a $25,000 fine.
A suspension for the rest of the season.
ruling: Stern suspended Rodman without pay for at least 11 games and fined him $25,000. Rodman had to meet with an NBA-designated counselor, and a decision on his return would come after the All-Star break. Stern said the suspension would continue until Rodman could give meaningful assurances that he would conduct himself within acceptable standards, including not putting others at physical risk.
rulebookNote: The source gives the 11 games as a minimum, tied to conditions for reinstatement, not a fixed term.
